conventions.F0_sign: each 2-forest contributes (-q_F^2) times the complementary edge monomial

documented_choices.best_single_sign_predictor: Among one Cayley determinant, leading-minor, or sorted-eigenvalue sign at a time, choose the rule 'signature failure iff that sign equals negative/zero/positive' with the fewest in-sample errors.
documented_choices.nonreference_side: At a canonical far-Euclidean point with all pair invariants large negative, size-k Cayley determinant sign is (-1)^(k-1): bubbles negative, triangles positive, boxes negative. A different sign or zero is labeled nonreference_or_surface. This sign label diagnoses connected components but does not by itself prove a unique real path crossing.
documented_choices.pair_invariants: For triangle and box, q_ij^2 is recomputed with the existing components() and q_square() logic after cutting propagators ei and ej.
documented_choices.subdiagrams: Pinched one-loop subdiagrams are principal Cayley submatrices on surviving propagator subsets, retaining the full box q_ij^2 values.

box.description: Cyclic box, ei=(vi,v{i+1}) and pi attached at vi.

bubble.description: Two parallel propagators; p1=p enters v1 and p2=-p enters v2.

crossed_double_box.description: Same seven internal edges as the planar double box, with p2 and p3 crossed: legs (p1,p2,p3,p4) attach to (v1,v6,v4,v5).

planar_double_box.description: Squares (v1,v2,v3,v4) and (v2,v5,v6,v3) share e2=(v2,v3); legs (p1,p2,p3,p4) attach to (v1,v4,v6,v5).

criterion_1.experiment_D_reassessment_reason: All sampled triangle failures, and no passes, lie on the negative-det(Y) side of the intruding leading-Landau surface; bubble has no failures.
criterion_1.rule: Fires when bubble or triangle signature-failure fraction is at least 0.10.

criterion_2.rule: Fires when at least half the tested paths have a detected transition farther than 0.10 from every listed candidate; partial if any path is far, lacks a pass-to-fail transition, has a control transition, or already fails at the lower endpoint. A path already failing at its lower endpoint is not called a transition.

literature_collision.reason: Not assessed by this computational test.
